narrative.intro: The ranking lists federal contract obligations by NAICS code for FY2027 to date. Total obligations for the period are $3.8B. Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers leads the list with $901M in obligations. Other Computer Related Services follows with $340M, Wired Telecommunications Carriers with $257M, and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) with $233M. The top ten also include Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing at $161M, Couriers and Express Delivery Services at $118M, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $115M, All Other Business Support Services at $104M, Logging at $99.6M, and Facilities Support Services at $96M. The list mixes health insurance, IT services, telecommunications, research, manufacturing, logistics, construction, business support, natural resources, and facilities work, showing a broad set of industries receiving obligations in the current fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: Which NAICS codes received the most federal obligations in FY2027 to date?
sections.body: Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers received $901M in obligations, the largest single NAICS on the list. Other Computer Related Services received $340M and Wired Telecommunications Carriers received $257M. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) received $233M.

sections.heading: What industry types appear among the top NAICS codes?
sections.body: Health insurance, IT services, and telecommunications appear near the top of the ranking. The top ten also include research, manufacturing, logistics, construction, business support, natural resources, and facilities services. These entries range from $96M to $901M in obligations.

faq.q: What are the biggest federal contracting industries?
faq.a: Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers is the biggest federal contracting industry with $901M in obligations. Other major industries by obligation are Other Computer Related Services at $340M, Wired Telecommunications Carriers at $257M, and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $233M. The top ten list also includes Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing at $161M, Couriers and Express Delivery Services at $118M, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $115M, All Other Business Support Services at $104M, Logging at $99.6M, and Facilities Support Services at $96M.
